label: Insomnia
phenotype_definition: UK Biobank field 1200: usually having trouble falling asleep or waking during the night versus never/rarely or sometimes
source_note: Jansen 2019 Nat Genet — UKB-only public release without 23andMe
pop_prev_citation: Jansen et al. 2019 report frequent-insomnia prevalence of 28.3% in the exact UK Biobank stratum and 29.9% in the full study; DOI 10.1038/s41588-018-0333-3. K=0.30 is a rounded phenotype-matched frequent-complaint convention, not the prevalence of clinically diagnosed insomnia disorder.

label: Sleep duration (continuous)
phenotype_definition: Continuous self-reported sleep duration in hours
source_note: Dashti 2019 Nat Commun — UKB continuous sleep duration

label: Short sleep (<7 h)
phenotype_definition: Self-reported sleep duration <7 h; 7–8 h controls
source_note: Dashti 2019 Nat Commun — UKB short-sleep tail

label: Long sleep (>=9 h)
phenotype_definition: Self-reported sleep duration >=9 h; 7–8 h controls
source_note: Dashti 2019 Nat Commun — UKB long-sleep tail

label: Chronotype / morningness
phenotype_definition: Definitely or more a morning person versus definitely or more an evening person in UK Biobank field 1180
source_note: Jones 2019 Nat Commun — UKB morningness

label: Daytime sleepiness
phenotype_definition: Continuous UKB daytime-sleepiness phenotype
source_note: Wang 2019 Nat Commun — UKB daytime sleepiness

label: Daytime napping
phenotype_definition: Daytime-napping frequency
source_note: Dashti 2021 Nat Commun — UKB daytime napping frequency

label: Habitual snoring
phenotype_definition: UK Biobank field 1210: yes versus no to whether a partner, close relative, or friend complains about the participant's snoring
source_note: Campos 2020 Nat Commun — UKB habitual snoring
pop_prev_citation: Campos et al. 2020 reports 37% prevalence in the analyzed UK Biobank European sample; cohort approximation for liability conversion, DOI 10.1038/s41467-020-14625-1

label: Sleep apnea
phenotype_definition: FinnGen R9 G6_SLEEPAPNO: hospital-discharge or cause-of-death ICD-10 G47.3 / ICD-9 3472, with G6_NARCOCATA and G6_SLEEPDISOTH excluded from controls
source_note: FinnGen R9 G6_SLEEPAPNO

label: Actigraphy sleep efficiency
phenotype_definition: Rank-normalized actigraphy sleep efficiency
source_note: Jones 2019 Nat Commun — GCST007803 European subset

label: Actigraphy sleep duration
phenotype_definition: Rank-normalized actigraphy SPT-window sleep duration
source_note: Jones 2019 Nat Commun — GCST007803 European subset

label: Actigraphy sleep timing
phenotype_definition: Rank-normalized actigraphy SPT-window midpoint
source_note: Jones 2019 Nat Commun — GCST007803 European subset

label: Alzheimer's disease
phenotype_definition: Bellenguez 2022 Stage I meta-analysis of clinically diagnosed Alzheimer disease and UK Biobank proxy-ADD based on parental dementia; UKB controls report neither dementia nor family history of dementia
source_note: Bellenguez 2022 Nat Genet — all-European Stage I discovery meta-analysis

label: Parkinson's disease
phenotype_definition: Nalls 2019 public European meta-analysis of 15,056 Parkinson disease cases plus 18,618 UK Biobank proxy cases without PD but with a first-degree relative with PD versus 449,056 controls
source_note: Nalls 2019 Lancet Neurol — public restricted-cohort-excluded release with UKB proxy cases

label: Major depressive disorder
phenotype_definition: Meta-analysis of UK Biobank broad-depression help-seeking cases (ever saw a GP or psychiatrist for nerves, anxiety, tension, or depression, with specified severe-psychiatric exclusions) and primarily clinically ascertained PGC_139k MDD, excluding 23andMe and overlapping earlier UK Biobank samples
source_note: Howard 2019 Nat Neurosci — public genome-wide UKB plus PGC_139k release without 23andMe

label: Schizophrenia
phenotype_definition: Schizophrenia or schizoaffective-disorder case status in the European-ancestry PGC3 Wave 3 core cohorts; each parent-proband trio contributes one case and one control
source_note: Trubetskoy 2022 Nature — PGC3 Wave 3 European autosomal stratum
pop_prev_citation: Trubetskoy et al. 2022 reports liability-scale prediction assuming 1% schizophrenia lifetime risk; DOI 10.1038/s41586-022-04434-5. K=0.01 preserves the primary study convention for this exact European stratum.

label: Bipolar disorder
phenotype_definition: Lifetime bipolar-disorder case status under DSM-IV, ICD-9, or ICD-10, established by structured interview, clinician checklist, medical-record review, or mostly ICD codes in the five external biobanks
source_note: Mullins 2021 Nat Genet — PGC3 all-bipolar-disorder cases

label: ADHD
phenotype_definition: ADHD case status from psychiatrist-assigned ICD-10 codes in iPSYCH, clinical ICD-10 diagnosis or ADHD-specific medication in deCODE, and ten European-ancestry PGC cohorts; controls are cohort-specific noncases
source_note: Demontis 2023 Nat Genet — iPSYCH, deCODE, and PGC European meta-analysis
pop_prev_citation: Demontis et al. 2019 explicitly used 5% population prevalence for liability-scale LDSC in the predecessor ADHD GWAS; DOI 10.1038/s41588-018-0269-7. K=0.05 preserves that published ADHD across-lifespan convention for the expanded 2023 meta-analysis, not a cohort-specific prevalence.

label: Inflammatory bowel disease
phenotype_definition: Combined inflammatory-bowel-disease case status in the de Lange 2017 European meta-analysis
source_note: de Lange 2017 Nat Genet — IIBDGC

label: Crohn's disease
phenotype_definition: Crohn's-disease case status in the de Lange 2017 European meta-analysis
source_note: de Lange 2017 Nat Genet — IIBDGC Crohn's stratum
pop_prev_citation: Carbonnel and Boutron 2017 report Crohn disease prevalence 331 per 100,000 in the population-based South Limburg study, compared with earlier European estimates up to 322 per 100,000; DOI 10.1093/ecco-jcc/jjx072. K=0.003 is a rounded high-prevalence European approximation, not a global prevalence.

label: Ulcerative colitis
phenotype_definition: Ulcerative-colitis case status in the de Lange 2017 European meta-analysis
source_note: de Lange 2017 Nat Genet — IIBDGC UC stratum
pop_prev_citation: Ng et al. 2017 report the highest European ulcerative-colitis prevalence as 505 per 100,000; DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(17)32448-0. K=0.005 is a rounded high-prevalence European approximation, not a global or cohort-specific prevalence.

label: Rheumatoid arthritis
phenotype_definition: Rheumatoid-arthritis case status in the Ishigaki 2022 European-only stratum
source_note: Ishigaki 2022 Nat Genet — European subset
pop_prev_citation: Ha et al. 2021 explicitly set rheumatoid-arthritis prevalence to 1% for EUR/EAS liability-scale LDSC; DOI 10.1136/annrheumdis-2020-219065. K=0.01 preserves that published RA genetic-analysis convention for the expanded Ishigaki 2022 European GWAS, not a cohort-specific prevalence estimate.

label: Multiple sclerosis
phenotype_definition: Multiple-sclerosis case status in the IMSGC 2019 15-cohort genome-wide discovery meta-analysis
source_note: IMSGC 2019 Science — genome-wide discovery stage only; MS-Chip and ImmunoChip samples are targeted replication

label: Asthma
phenotype_definition: Han 2020 main UK Biobank asthma: cases from doctor diagnosis, ICD-10 J45/J46, or self-report; controls free of asthma and allergic-disease diagnosis/self-report codes
source_note: Han 2020 Nat Commun — main all-ancestry UKB GWAS, distinct from the European sensitivity analysis

label: BMI
phenotype_definition: Continuous body-mass index
source_note: Yengo 2018 — GIANT+UKB

label: Type 2 diabetes
phenotype_definition: Type-2-diabetes case status in the BMI-unadjusted Mahajan 2018 DIAMANTE European meta-analysis
source_note: Mahajan 2018 Nat Genet — full BMI-unadjusted European meta-analysis; official download requires affirmative terms acceptance

label: LDL cholesterol
phenotype_definition: Inverse-normalized LDL cholesterol in the Graham 2021 European GLGC stratum
source_note: Graham 2021 Nature — GLGC

label: HDL cholesterol
phenotype_definition: Inverse-normalized HDL cholesterol in the Graham 2021 European GLGC stratum
source_note: Graham 2021 Nature — GLGC

label: Triglycerides
phenotype_definition: Inverse-normalized log triglycerides in the Graham 2021 European GLGC stratum
source_note: Graham 2021 Nature — GLGC

label: Coronary artery disease
phenotype_definition: Coronary artery disease case status under the study-specific case and control definitions documented for ten de novo cohorts and the prior CARDIoGRAMplusC4D inputs; the meta-analysis does not impose one uniform component-cohort definition
source_note: Aragam 2022 Nat Genet — primary predominantly European discovery meta-analysis

label: Stroke (any)
phenotype_definition: Any-stroke case status in the Mishra 2022 GIGASTROKE European stratum; subtype strata excluded
source_note: Mishra 2022 Nature — GIGASTROKE European subset
pop_prev_citation: CDC BRFSS 2020–2022 estimates age-standardized self-reported ever-stroke prevalence at 2.9% among US adults; DOI 10.15585/mmwr.mm7320a1. K=0.03 is a rounded adult-population approximation for liability scaling, not an age-specific or global lifetime-risk estimate.

label: Atrial fibrillation
phenotype_definition: Atrial-fibrillation case status in the Nielsen 2018 HRC-imputed European meta-analysis
source_note: Nielsen 2018 Nat Genet — AFGen
pop_prev_citation: 2016 ESC/EACTS atrial-fibrillation guideline estimates approximately 3% prevalence in adults aged 20 years or older; DOI 10.1093/eurheartj/ehw210. K=0.03 is an adult-population approximation for liability conversion, not a cohort-specific prevalence.

label: Systolic blood pressure
phenotype_definition: Continuous untransformed systolic blood pressure in mmHg; UK Biobank used the mean of two available automated or manual readings (one when only one was available) and added 15 mmHg for antihypertensive medication before the European UKB+ICBP meta-analysis
source_note: Evangelou 2018 Nat Genet — UKB+ICBP European SBP meta-analysis

label: Longevity (90th percentile)
phenotype_definition: Survival beyond the cohort-specific 90th percentile
source_note: Deelen 2019 Nat Commun
pop_prev_citation: Deelen et al. 2019 defines cases above the country-, sex-, and birth-cohort-specific 90th survival percentile and uses disease prevalence 0.10 for that phenotype in its power calculations; DOI 10.1038/s41467-019-11558-2. K=0.10 is therefore a phenotype-defined liability approximation, not a general-population lifetime prevalence.

label: Parental lifespan
phenotype_definition: Parental survival/lifespan with per-SNP sample size
source_note: Timmers 2019 eLife — GCST009890

label: Healthspan
phenotype_definition: Healthspan in genetically Caucasian British UKB participants
source_note: Zenin 2019 Commun Biol — GCST007406

label: Frailty index
phenotype_definition: Continuous frailty index in a European-descent meta-analysis
source_note: Atkins 2021 Aging Cell — GCST90020053

label: Leukocyte telomere length
phenotype_definition: Continuous leukocyte telomere length; public release is full-UKB mixed ancestry
source_note: Codd 2021 Nat Genet — full-UKB public release

label: Hand grip strength
phenotype_definition: Inverse-rank-normalized left-hand grip strength in white-British UKB participants
source_note: Neale Lab UKB round 2 — field 46

label: Breast cancer (overall)
phenotype_definition: Overall breast-cancer case status in the selected European-ancestry meta-analysis
source_note: Zhang 2020 Nat Genet — BCAC overall European release
pop_prev_citation: SEER Cancer Stat Facts: Female Breast Cancer, 2021-2023 lifetime risk 13.0% (US female population), https://seer.cancer.gov/statfacts/html/breast.html (accessed 2026-07-28); approximation for liability conversion, not a cohort-specific prevalence

label: Prostate cancer (overall)
phenotype_definition: Overall prostate-cancer case status in the selected European-ancestry meta-analysis
source_note: Schumacher 2018 Nat Genet — PRACTICAL EUR fixed-effect meta-analysis
pop_prev_citation: SEER Cancer Stat Facts: Prostate Cancer, 2021-2023 lifetime risk 13.2% (US male population), https://seer.cancer.gov/statfacts/html/prost.html (accessed 2026-07-28); approximation for liability conversion, not a cohort-specific prevalence

label: Colorectal cancer
phenotype_definition: Colorectal-cancer case status in the Fernandez-Rozadilla 2023 European-only main stratum
source_note: Fernandez-Rozadilla 2023 Nat Genet — European stratum

label: Lung cancer
phenotype_definition: Overall lung-cancer case status across histological subtypes in the McKay 2017 European meta-analysis
source_note: McKay 2017 Nat Genet — ILCCO overall lung cancer

label: Cutaneous melanoma
phenotype_definition: Histopathologically confirmed cutaneous-melanoma case status in the Landi 2020 confirmed-only meta-analysis
source_note: Landi 2020 Nat Genet — dbGaP pha004971 confirmed-only genome-wide analysis; excludes self-reported UKB and 23andMe strata

label: Ovarian cancer (all invasive epithelial)
phenotype_definition: All invasive epithelial ovarian-cancer case status
source_note: Phelan 2017 Nat Genet — OCAC European GCST004462
pop_prev_citation: SEER Cancer Stat Facts: Ovarian Cancer, 2021-2023 lifetime risk 1.1% (US women), https://seer.cancer.gov/statfacts/html/ovary.html (accessed 2026-07-28); approximation for liability conversion, not a cohort-specific European prevalence
